projects.title: Blackjack AI
projects.description: Trained a Blackjack-playing agent using custom implementations of Monte Carlo, Temporal Difference, and Q-Learning under both fixed and epsilon-greedy policies. Evaluated policies through simulated trajectories, state-action value tracking, and reward-based updates with discounting and dynamic learning rates.
